card.name: Modal or helpful verbs before benefit
card.fires_on: Modal or helpful words such as can, may, should, useful, help that come before a verb or phrase about usefulness or what something enables. Seen mostly in informational web prose.

modes.label: Modal verbs
modes.description: Can, may or should placed after a subject, setting up what is possible or expected.
